_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes: Strengthens Valinor USB command integrity with tagged CRC-16, bounded writes and retries, and exact parsed-EXEC verification. Firmware rev27v-gauge-29 preserves the existing Max-preset control profile. This release is intentionally unsigned: for the official GitHub installer, select More info, verify SmartCuff_Setup.exe, then select Run anyway.
